title: Reports | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Reports
hero.lead: Reports turn data from Kaderblick into charts. The four-step Mobile Wizard provides a quick route; the Report Builder gives experienced users full control.

body:
Saved reports

My reports displays saved reports as cards. The number beside the heading is the number of loaded entries. Each card identifies the chart type, name and description.

  • Show preview: opens the chart inside the card; Hide preview closes it.
  • Dashboard: adds the report to your personal dashboard. If a template still needs a team or player, select that context when prompted.
  • Edit: opens the saved configuration in the Report Builder.
  • Delete: removes your own report after confirmation. The action is not available for fixed templates.

Select New report to start the Mobile Wizard.

Choose the right workflow

WorkflowBest forHow to open it
Mobile WizardCreating a report quickly with only a few decisions.New report, or Dashboard → Add widget → Statistics widget → Simple wizard.
Report BuilderControlling the data source, grouping, metric, filters and presentation.Select Customize on the final wizard page, or Dashboard → Add widget → Statistics widget → Detailed builder.

Customize transfers all selections made in the wizard to the Report Builder; you do not start again.

Mobile Wizard: create a report in four steps

The wizard guides you through the required choices. Back lets you revise an earlier choice; Next becomes available once the current required choice is complete. The progress indicator shows your position.

1. Choose the report subject

  • Our team: analyse one team’s values.
  • A specific player: focus on one player.
  • Compare teams: place several teams side by side.
  • Compare players: place several players side by side.
  • Requirements & evidence: analyse the completion status of requirements and evidence.
  • Acceptances and declines: analyse responses to matches and events.

2. Define the context

This page depends on step 1. For Our team, select the teams. In the verified screen, leaving all teams unselected aggregates all available team data. Player and comparison reports request the corresponding players or comparison items.

3. Choose a metric

For Our team, the verified choices were goals, assists, shots, cards, fouls, passes, minutes played, distance and season progress. Other report subjects receive their own relevant metrics, which appear only after the subject is selected.

4. Choose the period

The verified team report offered Current season, Last 10 matches, Last month and All available data. The final page opens afterwards.

Review the final page

Review the suggested name and change it if necessary. Presentation type lists charts suitable for the current combination. The verified team report offered doughnut, bar and pie charts. Hide entries without a value removes empty categories.

The preview displays the result. If no data exists for the combination, Kaderblick says so in the preview. Select Save or Customize. Customize opens the Report Builder with your existing selections.

Report Builder: full configuration

The Report Builder separates the configuration into Basics, Data & chart, Filters and Options. The preview remains visible and recalculates after changes.

Basics: name or quick-start template

Enter a clear name and description, or begin with a quick-start template. Templates are grouped under All, Players, Team & season, Comparison and Weather & pitch. A template fills the related fields, which remain editable in every section.

Data & chart: define the chart content

  • What do you want to analyse? selects the data source. Verified sources are Matches and performance, Requirements and evidence and Acceptances and declines.
  • Analyse by defines which items form the chart values, such as players.
  • What to measure? selects the calculated value, such as goals.
  • Additionally split by adds another grouping when available.
  • Swap fields exchanges the two compatible assignments.
  • Chart type controls the presentation; choose from the types offered for the current configuration.

Filters: narrow the data set

Under Season / period, choose All data, Current season, Specific season or Date range. The verified configuration also offered team, player, match type, event type, pitch type and weather (precipitation). The number on the Filters tab is the number of active filters.

If the preview is empty, check the period, team and player filters first.

Options: refine the presentation

Options depend on the chart type. In the verified doughnut configuration, Central value, Show legend, Show data labels and Hide entries without a value were visible. Moving average was disabled and marked as unavailable for this chart type.

Save and use on the dashboard

  1. Review the name and preview.
  2. Check Filters for unintended restrictions.
  3. Save the report.
  4. Use Dashboard on its card, or select it when adding a statistics widget.

A dashboard widget uses the saved report. Edit its configuration through Edit on the report card.

Where the report data comes from

  • Matches supply match and performance data.
  • Requirements and evidence supply completion statuses.
  • My matchday and events supply acceptances and declines.
  • Dashboard displays saved reports as statistics widgets.

Visibility by role and relation

The teams, players, requirements and responses available depend on your account’s permissions and relations. If an expected item is missing, first check whether your account is connected to that team or person.
